heading: Find out why your website is not converting.
subtitle: Paste your URL and receive a focused review on clarity, trust, positioning and conversion friction.
howItWorksText: The AI analyzes your website structure, messaging and user experience, then returns a concise strategic review.
inputText: Use a public URL for the most accurate review.
toneText: Direct, ironic, annoyingly precise. It is not a joke. It is worse.
noteText: The roast is free. Fixing the site is the part we do together.
analyzingText: We are reading the site and preparing a strategic assessment.
analyzingTime: It can take from 30 to 90 seconds.
slowServer: The servers are busy, so this is taking longer than usual.
funnelRunningText: Reusing cached snapshot to estimate conversion leaks and behavioral patterns.
emptyReview: The strategic review will appear here, structured and ready for action.
simulationDescription: Are users leaving your site? Click to discover exactly where and why.
ctaText: Find out what actually works on your website and what is slowing down your results. Kremisi gives you direct feedback on design, development, and structure.
invalidUrl: The URL you entered does not look valid.
securityRequired: Complete the security check before starting the review.
securityUnavailable: The security check is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
securityFailed: Security check failed. Refresh the page and try again.
reviewFailed: Could not complete the review. Try again.
unreadableSite: The website returned empty content. This may happen when the homepage is not readable or blocks crawling. Send a link to an internal page (for example About) and try again.
noFunnelCache: Funnel cache is not available for this review. Run Start Review again.
prepareSnapshot: Run Start Review first to prepare the cached page snapshot.
snapshotMissing: Cached snapshot missing or expired. Run Start Review again.
snapshotExpired: Cached snapshot expired. Run Start Review again.
funnelFailed: Could not complete the simulation. Try again.

competitive.title: Competitive Position
competitive.subtitle: Execution gap across the category
competitive.chartLabel: Competitive position radar chart comparing your site, top competitor, and category average
competitive.lockedText: Submit a website to replace this preview with an AI-estimated competitive position read.
competitive.insight: The page has a strong structural base, but the remaining gap is sharper differentiation.
competitive.methodNote: Synthetic preview. Final chart is generated from the submitted site.

explanations.Trust: The opening area does not show named proof, quantified outcomes, or authority badges near the first action.
explanations.UX: Primary actions are not consistently repeated through sections, so users must scan to find the next step.
explanations.SEO: Headings and service copy include explicit intent terms, but the page still needs more specific wording to fully own its search intent.
explanations.Offer: Service intent is visible, but scope and deliverables are not summarized early in one compact block.
explanations.Branding: Visual style is coherent, yet the unique promise is not repeated consistently across headline, proof, and CTA copy.
explanations.Conversion: CTA priority softens after the hero and the contact path lacks urgency cues near the action point.
